_comment: GENERATED by scripts/dev/gen-recipes.sh from the catalogs named in sources (ADR 0023): never edit it by hand; change the catalog and run scripts/dev/gen-recipes.sh --write.

template.fix: Use native assert() with class type-hints, or proper type declarations.
template.why: Some assertion helpers changed.

template.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: return a render array ['#type' => 'processed_text', '#text' => $text, '#format' => $format_id] instead of flattened markup (works on Drupal 10 and 11, and keeps the cacheability metadata); the call site changes from a string to a render array.

lifecycle.replacement: a render array ['#type' => 'processed_text', '#text' => $text, '#format' => $format_id] (core's 'There is no direct replacement'): the call site changes from a string to a render array

template.why: check_markup() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). There is no direct replacement.

template.fix: Migrate the editor config/plugins to CKEditor 5 (often non-mechanical — consider Phase 2).
template.why: CKEditor 4 removed; CKEditor 5 is the only core editor.

template.fix: Inject the 'database' connection service and use its query builders.
template.why: Procedural database API removed.

template.fix: Constructor-inject the service via create()/ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (Phase 2).
template.why: Static \Drupal:: service access is discouraged (and brittle to test).

template.fix: Implement create() and inject the services you need.
template.why: Forms/controllers should inject services, not call \Drupal:: statically.

template.fix: Inject and use the 'messenger' service ($this->messenger()->addStatus(...)).
template.why: Global message helper removed.

template.fix: Use Url::fromRoute()/fromUri() and the 'url_generator' service.
template.why: \Drupal::url() removed.

template.fix: Use the 'entity_type.manager' service: ->getStorage('node')->load($id).
template.why: Procedural entity loaders removed.

template.fix: Use EntityTypeManagerInterface (and the dedicated repository/field managers).
template.why: EntityManager split up.

template.fix: Inject the 'date.formatter' service and call ->format().
template.why: format_date() removed.

template.fix: Replace with a native/JS alternative or the contrib jquery_ui_* shims; re-evaluate the UI in Phase 2.
template.why: jQuery UI libraries removed from core.

template.fix: Use createMock()/createStub() and the modern matcher API; remove at().
template.why: Legacy PHPUnit mock APIs removed in PHPUnit 10/11.

template.fix: Inject the 'datetime.time' service: ->getRequestTime().
template.why: REQUEST_TIME constant removed.

template.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed while the core floor is below 11.4: DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.4.0', fn() => \Drupal::service(TextSummary::class)->generate($text, $format, $size), fn() => text_summary($text, $format, $size)) - a bare TextSummary call fatals on older cores. generate() needs an int size: pass the text.settings default_summary_length when the original passed NULL.

lifecycle.replacement: \Drupal::service(\Drupal\text\TextSummary::class)->generate($text, $format, $size) - $size must be an int (core's wrapper falls back to text.settings default_summary_length)

template.why: text_summary() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). Its replacement, the TextSummary service, exists only from Drupal 11.4.

template.fix: Use Twig's whitespace control: the '-' modifier ({%- ... -%}, {{- ... -}}) trims the whitespace next to a tag. Never move to the 'spaceless' filter: it is deprecated since Twig 3.12.
template.why: Twig {% spaceless %} removed in Twig 3.

template.fix: Keep existing hook_update_N intact; do not renumber. Add new ones only for real schema/config changes.
template.why: Update path semantics matter for a port.

template.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: inline core's own body, e.g. setrawcookie('Drupal.visitor.' . $field, rawurlencode($value), \Drupal::time()->getRequestTime() + 31536000, '/') - works on every core.

lifecycle.replacement: no core replacement - inline core's body: setrawcookie('Drupal.visitor.' . $field, rawurlencode($value), \Drupal::time()->getRequestTime() + 31536000, '/')
no core replacement - inline core's body: setrawcookie('Drupal.visitor.' . $cookie_name, '', \Drupal::time()->getRequestTime() - 3600, '/')

template.why: user_cookie_save()/user_cookie_delete() are deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 with no replacement (soft: they still work on every Drupal 11 and 12 core).

template.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: $users = \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('user')->loadByProperties(['name' => $name]) (or ['mail' => $mail]); $account = $users ? reset($users) : FALSE; - works on Drupal 10 and 11.

lifecycle.replacement: \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('user')->loadByProperties(['name' => $name]), then reset() (FALSE when empty) - exactly what core's deprecated body does
\Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('user')->loadByProperties(['mail' => $mail]), then reset() (FALSE when empty) - exactly what core's deprecated body does

template.why: user_load_by_name()/user_load_by_mail() are deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0: they still work on every Drupal 11 and 12 core (a SOFT deprecation).

template.fix: Use \Drupal\user\Entity\Role::loadMultiple() (available on Drupal 10) and filter inline: user_roles(TRUE) excluded the anonymous role (RoleInterface::ANONYMOUS_ID); user_role_names() mapped the roles to $role->label().

lifecycle.replacement: \Drupal\user\Entity\Role::loadMultiple(), skipping RoleInterface::ANONYMOUS_ID for user_roles(TRUE) (and filtering by permission inline when one was passed)
\Drupal\user\Entity\Role::loadMultiple() mapped to $role->label() (skip RoleInterface::ANONYMOUS_ID for the membersonly variant)

template.why: user_roles() and user_role_names() were deprecated in drupal:10.2.0 and REMOVED in drupal:11.0.0: a call is an undefined-function fatal on every Drupal 11 core (a HARD deprecation, always fixed in Phase 1).
A config/install or config/optional file has no matching config schema key: core's config validation and translation cannot type it. Add the schema to config/schema/<module>.schema.yml.
The info.yml configure: route is defined by no routing file, so core's module list drops the Configure link. Point it at the module's settings route.
A Block, Condition, Filter, FieldFormatter or FieldWidget plugin with its own settings has no settings schema, so only core's generic fallback covers it. Add the plugin's settings schema.
A service passes another number of arguments than its class constructor takes: fewer is an ArgumentCountError, more are silently ignored. Align the arguments with the constructor.

A service class in the extension's namespace has no src/ file (an orphan service: fetching it is a fatal error), or exists only with another letter case. Remove the service, restore its class, or fix the case.
A submodule's core_version_requirement does not admit the target core (or is missing), so core refuses to install it. Set it to the parent's constraint.
The code uses a module its info.yml does not list in dependencies: core may enable the module without it. Declare the dependency (check the project name of a contrib one).

from.capture: ^'([^']+)' does not match the real file

template.why: A class referenced from *.services.yml / *.routing.yml, or a PSR-4 class declaration, whose case differs from the real file name. Works on case-insensitive filesystems (macOS) and fatals on Linux.

template.fix: Use [$this, 'method'], [static::class, 'method'], '::method' or a function-name string under #submit/#validate/#ajax/#process/...
template.why: A first-class callable is a closure; closures cannot be serialized, so a cached form (#ajax, form state cache) fatals.

template.fix: Do not add #[\Override] while core_version_requirement spans Drupal 10 or an older 11.x minor; add it only when every declared core has the parent method.
template.why: #[\Override] on a method whose parent exists only in newer cores is a compile-time fatal on PHP 8.3+ with the older cores you still declare.

template.fix: Keep/restore 'implements ContainerFactoryPluginInterface' and its use statement (check-port-safety.sh).
template.why: A class with create() must implement ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (plugins) or ContainerInjectionInterface (forms/controllers); QueueWorkerBase, BlockBase, FilterBase, ActionBase and core PluginBase do not provide it.

template.fix: Keep/restore 'implements ContainerFactoryPluginInterface' and its use statement (check-port-safety.sh).
template.why: A class with create() must implement ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (plugins) or ContainerInjectionInterface (forms/controllers); QueueWorkerBase, BlockBase, FilterBase, ActionBase and core PluginBase do not provide it.

template.fix: Declare injected services protected and non-readonly in forms and plugins.
template.why: DependencySerializationTrait runs from the base-class scope: __sleep() drops private child properties and __wakeup() cannot re-initialize readonly ones.

template.fix: Keep 'new static(' (or make the class final in Phase 2); never change it to silence the sandbox PHPStan.
template.why: new self() in create() of a non-final class hands subclasses a parent instance.

template.d10_compat: Safe for ^10 || ^11: 10.2+ accepts the argument, and PHP ignores an extra argument on older 10.x/9.x cores.
template.fix: Add TypedConfigManagerInterface $typed_config_manager to the subclass constructor, forward it (parent::__construct($config_factory, $typed_config_manager)) and pass $container->get('config.typed') from create().
template.why: ConfigFormBase::__construct() takes a second argument, TypedConfigManagerInterface $typedConfigManager: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.2-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass constructor that calls parent::__construct($config_factory) alone throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.

template.d10_compat: Safe for ^10 || ^11: 10.3+ accepts the argument, and PHP ignores an extra argument on older cores.
template.fix: Accept TimeInterface $time in the subclass constructor, forward it as the third parent argument and pass $container->get('datetime.time') from create().
template.why: ContentTranslationController::__construct() takes a third argument, TimeInterface $time: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.3-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass passing only the manager and the entity field manager throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.

template.d10_compat: Core's getOriginal() does not exist below 11.2: code kept for ^10 must not call it on core entities (use the deprecated ->original property, or DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall()).
template.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local helper (e.g. getOriginalWidget()) and update its callers. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's getOriginal().
template.why: Drupal 11.2 added EntityInterface::getOriginal(): ?static (implemented by EntityBase). An entity class that already declares its own getOriginal() without a compatible return type is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+; a compatible one silently replaces core's method there.

template.fix: While the floor is below 11.2: keep the ->original property, or wrap the call in DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall() (core 10.1+): backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.2', fn() => $entity->getOriginal(), fn() => $entity->original). Raise the floor to ^11.2 to use it directly.
template.why: ->getOriginal()/->setOriginal() on a core entity exist only from Drupal 11.2; while the declared range includes an older core the call is an 'undefined method' fatal there (unless the receiver is the module's own class).

template.d10_compat: Core's setOriginal() does not exist below 11.2.
template.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local method. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's setOriginal().
template.why: Drupal 11.2 added EntityInterface::setOriginal(?EntityInterface $original): static. An entity class declaring its own setOriginal() with another signature is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+.

template.d10_compat: An optional second parameter works on every core; a required one breaks Drupal 10 and 11.0-11.2.
template.fix: Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
template.why: From 11.3 core invokes hook_entity_operation() with a second argument, CacheableMetadata $cacheability (EntityListBuilder::getOperations()); earlier cores pass only the entity. An implementation that REQUIRES the second parameter throws ArgumentCountError on every core below 11.3.

template.d10_compat: An optional third parameter works on every core; a required one breaks Drupal 10 and 11.0-11.2.
template.fix: Keep the two-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
template.why: From 11.3 core alters entity operations with a third argument, CacheableMetadata $cacheability; earlier cores pass only (&$operations, $entity). An implementation that REQUIRES the third parameter throws ArgumentCountError below 11.3.

template.d10_compat: Never add #[\Override] to it while the core floor is below 11.3: the parent method does not exist there and PHP 8.3+ fatals at compile time.
template.fix: Rename the module's helper (e.g. buildWidgetRevisionCacheId()) unless overriding core's revision cache id on 11.3+ is intended; if kept, match protected function buildRevisionCacheId($id): string exactly.
template.why: Drupal 11.3 added ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId($id): string, which core calls for its revision memory/persistent cache. A storage subclass declaring a method with that name becomes an override of core on 11.3+ (core then uses its cache ids); with an incompatible signature (no ': string', private, other parameters) it is a fatal at class load on 11.3+.
